correlation_analysis.analysis_summary: No log events were provided for analysis, therefore no direct event-to-technique mappings could be created. All retrieved MITRE techniques remain unmapped due to the absence of corresponding event data.
overall_recommendations: Implement continuous monitoring of Windows Event Log service status and audit policy changes to detect attempts to disable or tamper with logging (T1562.002).
Deploy log integrity solutions (e.g., Windows Event Forwarding with secure channels, immutable storage) to ensure logs cannot be cleared without detection (T1070.001).
Enforce strict permissions on cloud logging configurations and enable alerting on modifications to services such as AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, or Office 365 audit logs (T1562.008).
Ensure Linux audit daemon (auditd) is running and its configuration files are protected from unauthorized changes (T1562.012).
Configure command‑history preservation (e.g., enforce HISTSIZE, protect .bash_history) and monitor for attempts to clear or disable it (T1562.003).
